method: Read-only desk research: the Engine repository (bindings, resolver, discovery config, prior session records), the 2026-11-22 sensor-source plan, and public program pages found by web search. No temperature value was fetched. Access to waterqualitydata.us and api.waterdata.usgs.gov was refused by this session's network proxy (CONNECT 403), so no endpoint, station list or robots/terms page was verified from here. Every row is an EVIDENCE_LEAD until the Mac mini census verifies it.
